title: Shen-Ling-Bai-Zhu-San alleviates ulcerative colitis by enhancing mitophagy via the Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin pathway.
authors: Wang, Huan; Han, Jian; Li, Lin; Li, Yan; Yang, Jun; Qiu, Wangzhong; Yao, Liuhua; Zhou, Jianjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin通路增强线粒体自噬缓解溃疡性结肠炎，仅涉及分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Shen-Ling-Bai-Zhu-San (SLBZS), a classic formula, shows excellent therapeutic effects on ulcerative colitis (UC). However, its pharmacological mechanism remains unclear. This study aims to explore the SLBZS's mechanism on mitophagy and inflammation in UC. METHOD: The UC rat model was constructed using 4.5% DSS. The in vivo effects of SLBZS on mitophagy and inflammation were investigated by combining the autophagy inhibitor 3-MA. Caco-2 cells were co-treated with DSS and LPS to mimic UC-like inflammatory. The main active components of SLBZS were analyzed by HPLC. Combined with 3-MA or knockdown of Nrf2, the mechanism by which the main active component of SLBZS Ginsenoside Rg1 affected oxidative stress and inflammation was investigated. RESULTS: SLBZS administration alleviated colonic injury in UC rats, reduced disease activity index, increased colonic length, promoted ZO-1, occludin, LGR5, and MUC-2 expressions, decreased ROS production, MDA level, and TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-17, and p62 expressions, increased SOD and GSH-PX levels, mitochondrial membrane potential, and PINK1, TOM20, Nrf2, LC3, PINK1, and Parkin levels. 3-MA prevented this phenomenon, indicating that SLBZS inhibited UC inflammation by enhancing mitophagy. The molecular docking results showed that Ginsenoside Rg1 bound to Nrf2. The interaction between Nrf2 and PINK1 was confirmed. Mechanistically, Ginsenoside Rg1 relieved oxidative stress and inflammation in UC-like Caco-2 cell model by Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin pathway-mediated mitophagy. CONCLUSION: Our results indicated that the Ginsenoside Rg1 promoted Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin pathway-mediated mitophagy, thereby alleviating UC, suggesting that Ginsenoside Rg1 could serve as a promising therapeutic agent for clinical UC, with the Nrf2/ PINK1/Parkin axis representing a potential strategy.
abstract_zh: 背景：参苓白术散（SLBZS）作为一种经典方剂，对溃疡性结肠炎（UC）显示出优异的治疗效果。然而，其药理机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨SLBZS在UC中对线粒体自噬和炎症的作用机制。方法：采用4.5% DSS构建UC大鼠模型。结合自噬抑制剂3-MA，研究SLBZS在体内对线粒体自噬和炎症的影响。Caco-2细胞经DSS和LPS联合处理以模拟UC样炎症。通过HPLC分析SLBZS的主要活性成分。结合3-MA或Nrf2敲低，研究SLBZS主要活性成分人参皂苷Rg1影响氧化应激和炎症的机制。结果：SLBZS给药减轻了UC大鼠的结肠损伤，降低了疾病活动指数，增加了结肠长度，促进了ZO-1、occludin、LGR5和MUC-2的表达，减少了ROS产生、MDA水平以及TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、IL-17和p62的表达，增加了SOD和GSH-PX水平、线粒体膜电位以及PINK1、TOM20、Nrf2、LC3、PINK1和Parkin的水平。3-MA阻止了这一现象，表明SLBZS通过增强线粒体自噬抑制UC炎症。分子对接结果显示，人参皂苷Rg1与Nrf2结合。Nrf2与PINK1之间的相互作用得到确认。机制上，人参皂苷Rg1通过Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin通路介导的线粒体自噬缓解了UC样Caco-2细胞模型中的氧化应激和炎症。结论：我们的结果表明，人参皂苷Rg1促进了Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin通路介导的线粒体自噬，从而缓解UC，提示人参皂苷Rg1可作为临床UC的有前景治疗药物，而Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin轴代表了一种潜在策略。
